evidence.detail: AdventureBookInterface rs/n/c/c owns a singleton rs/l/f/a/k/a, constructs it in its static initializer and registers it directly against widget 38388 immediately after creating the exact literal 'Chapter Progress' and the initial '0 / 5' progress text.

AdventureBookInterfacePacketHandler rs/n/c/d ScriptPacket 22 operation 8 reads two integers into rs/n/c/c.bJ and bK; rs/l/f/a/k/a consumes exactly bJ / bK as its progress fraction and has no unrelated domain state.

The renderer obtains the live client BufferedImage Graphics2D, enables antialiasing and pure stroke control, then draws a green 3px Arc2D ring with extent -360 * (bJ / bK), giving a direct circular chapter-progress visualization.

The class extends the client render-component base rs/l/f/b/d and is registered/unregistered through rs/l/f/e using its inherited widget-position contract, proving it is a renderer component rather than Adventure Book data or packet state.

proposals.note: AdventureBookChapterProgressRenderer is fixed by the exact AdventureBookInterface ownership/registration, the literal 'Chapter Progress' widget join, ScriptPacket 22 op-8 counters and the class's sole green Arc2D progress-ring behavior. Confidence is 0.999.
